# CardHearth

> CardHearth is a free online home for classic solitaire, card and puzzle games — played in the browser with no download and no sign-up. It is built around fairness: every Sudoku is solvable by pure logic, every Mahjong board is guaranteed clearable, and FreeCell uses the standard Microsoft deal numbering (so deal #11982 is the one famously unsolvable deal). Operated by Einherjar Ventures LLC.

## Games

- [Klondike Solitaire](https://cardhearth.com/klondike/): the classic one-deck solitaire (Draw 1 or Draw 3).
- [Spider Solitaire](https://cardhearth.com/spider/): two-deck suit-building at 1, 2 or 4 suits.
- [FreeCell](https://cardhearth.com/freecell/): open, almost-always-winnable solitaire with Microsoft deal numbering.
- [Pyramid](https://cardhearth.com/pyramid/): pair cards that sum to 13.
- [TriPeaks](https://cardhearth.com/tripeaks/): clear three peaks on a rank-by-rank streak.
- [Golf](https://cardhearth.com/golf/): quick play-up-or-down rounds.
- [Yukon](https://cardhearth.com/yukon/): move any face-up pile, no stock.
- [Scorpion](https://cardhearth.com/scorpion/): build down in suit and untangle the sting.
- [Forty Thieves](https://cardhearth.com/forty-thieves/): two decks, a serious challenge.
- [Eight Off](https://cardhearth.com/eight-off/): eight free cells; almost every deal winnable.
- [Hearts](https://cardhearth.com/hearts/): trick-taking vs the computer — dodge the points.
- [Spades](https://cardhearth.com/spades/): bid, partner up, take the tricks vs the computer.
- [Gin Rummy](https://cardhearth.com/gin/): meld sets and runs and knock, vs the computer.
- [Euchre](https://cardhearth.com/euchre/): order up trump and name the bowers, vs the computer.
- [Sudoku](https://cardhearth.com/sudoku/): logic puzzle, four difficulties, every puzzle solvable by logic.
- [Mahjong](https://cardhearth.com/mahjong/): match free tiles; every board guaranteed solvable.
- [Minesweeper](https://cardhearth.com/minesweeper/): read the numbers, dodge the mines.
- [2048](https://cardhearth.com/2048/): slide and merge to the 2048 tile.
- [Daily Challenge](https://cardhearth.com/daily-challenge/): one shared puzzle a day, rotating Sudoku, Mahjong, FreeCell and 2048 — every deal solvable, except FreeCell where unsolvable deals are about 1 in 76,000; keep a streak.

## Deal numbers

- [FreeCell deal numbers](https://cardhearth.com/freecell/deals/): play any deal by its Windows/Microsoft number (1–1,000,000), including the unsolvable #11982.
- [Klondike deal numbers](https://cardhearth.com/klondike/deals/): replay or share any Klondike deal by number.
- [Spider deal numbers](https://cardhearth.com/spider/deals/): replay or share any Spider deal by number.
